name: Narset, Parter of Veils
oracle_text:
Each opponent can't draw more than one card each turn.
−2: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: Each opponent can't draw more than one card each turn.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "opponent") capping how many cards the affected player may draw each turn (max 1), counting every draw that turn including ones made before the permanent entered (cards_drawn_this_turn ledger); any draw beyond the cap simply does not happen (rule 121.2-style 'can't' draw, not a replacement)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_draw only multiplies draws (draw_multiplier) and skip_draw_step only removes the draw step; static_max_per_turn is read only by cast_from_graveyard permissions; cant_cast_spells / cant_gain_life are the right player-wide 'can't' shape but no static forbids drawing
